flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch/list/NoticeSearchAllList.tsx (notice_no, processing_stage columns, checkbox), pages/Notice/detail/PaymentDetails.tsx (Payment Flag, display only), utils/Meta/System.ts ('Court Payment Due Date' parameter page). There is no per-notice input form for composition amount / payment due date / payment acceptance flag in the staff portal.
note: The story asks for a screen that shows key notice info (notice number, processing stage) plus input fields (composition amount, payment due date, allow/disallow flag) so the officer can review and fill them in before saving. What exists: the Notice Search list shows notice_no and processing_stage (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:139, :156) and the notice detail page shows 'Payment Flag' only as read-only text (PaymentDetails.tsx:61). There are no input fields for amount, due date or flag per notice, and no review-then-save step in the staff portal. The flag/amount/due date only change through API requests from PLUS (see OCMS48.2). The 'Court Payment Due Date' parameter page (System.ts:155) is only a system-parameter menu entry; no backend usage was found in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi or ocmseserviceapi, so it is not counted as a per-notice input. The sheet status 'Demo paid' cannot be confirmed from the repo, cannot verify from repo what was demoed.
recommendation: Claim very little. Only the (generic) display of notice number and stage exists; the input fields and officer review-then-save flow are not in the repo. Ask URA/the team to show the demoed screen or confirm the story is met through the PLUS API.

steps.step: OCMS displays key notice info (notice number, processing stage)
steps.detail: The Notice Search list shows notice_no (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:139) and processing_stage (:156). It is the generic search result list for all functions, not a view dedicated to enabling/disabling payment, hence Sebagian (consistent with OCMS48.1 step 3).

steps.step: OCMS provides input fields for composition amount, payment due date and the allow/disallow flag
steps.detail: Payment Flag is only shown as text (PaymentDetails.tsx:61-65, source NOTICE_VALID.paymentAcceptanceAllowed); there is no editable input. No per-notice composition amount or payment due date input was found in ocmsadminui. 'Court Payment Due Date' in System.ts:155-158 is just a system-parameter page entry.

steps.step: Officer reviews and fills in the inputs before saving
steps.detail: There is no review-then-save flow in the staff portal for these three values. Saving only exists in the API called by PLUS (CasIntegrationController.java:220-222, see OCMS48.2), not triggered by an officer from the UI.
